Discount Effectiveness: The data reveals a clear inverse relationship between discount depth and profit margin — higher discounts erode margins significantly. While discounts may drive volume (quantity per order), the margin sacrifice must be weighed against the incremental revenue. The trend line on the scatter plot quantifies the margin erosion per percentage point of discount, providing a benchmark for promotional planning.

Actionable Insight: Discount tiers in the 1–10% range appear to generate volume with more moderate margin erosion than steeper discounts. Discounts above 15% should be scrutinized — the volume uplift typically does not compensate for the margin loss. Consider capping promotional discounts and focusing on targeted offers rather than broad-based discounting.
